scenario_description:
Objective: Keep postponed trash disposal from turning staged food waste into an overnight wildlife-attraction problem around the cabin.
Emerging Need: A planned transfer-station run first appears routine, then closure, nearby bear activity, and outside bag storage make the situation time-sensitive.
Decision Context: Stored waste-handling guidance defines when ordinary shed storage is unsafe, which same-day tote route fits, and which wildlife actions remain out of scope.
Consequence: Once the tote route closes, no animal disturbance has occurred, but the bags remain exposed through the active evening period without the intended preventive option.

parameter.title: Transfer station trash run
parameter.description: Drop kitchen trash and recycling before dusk.

parameter.subject: Transfer station early closure Feb 17
parameter.body: The Montpelier rural drop-off gates will close today at 13:00 for equipment repair. Food-waste and trash drop-offs resume tomorrow at 08:00.

parameter.subject: Bear activity reported near East Hill
parameter.body: Fresh bear tracks and two tipped curb bins were reported overnight within one mile of East Hill Road. Residents should secure food waste before dusk; no nuisance bear response is underway.

parameter.content: When I grabbed the snow stakes from your shed, I noticed two black kitchen trash bags beside the mower. The shed latch is just the old hook-and-eye; no damage and no animals inside.

parameter.name: Bear Hill Waste Tote Pickup
parameter.notes: Same-day bear-resistant tote and food-waste bag pickup list closes at 14:00. Routine requests should include bag count, shed or porch access, latch condition, whether the transfer station is unavailable, and confirmation that no animal is currently present.

parameter.subject: Same-day tote route closed for Feb 17
parameter.body: The 14:00 same-day wildlife-resistant tote route has closed. Remaining calls today are limited to active animal-in-trash incidents; routine food-waste bag pickups can be placed on tomorrow morning's list.
